title: Protocol for ESBL-EC Recovery from Stool Samples
author: Sarah Gallichan
materials: Suspend 50 g in 1 L distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare Sterile Buffered Peptone Water (BPW)
steps.instruction: Prepare and sterilize BPW pre-enrichment broth for sample preparation.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 g of BPW powder to 1 L of distilled water.
Mix well and sterilize by autoclaving at 121 °C.
Store at room temperature for up to 1 month.
Aliquot 5 mL into 15 mL falcon tubes.

steps.title: Prepare Stool Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a maltodextrin:trehalose stool solution for sample resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 9.4 g of maltodextrin and 3.1 g of trehalose in 450 mL of PBS using a waterbath set to 40 °C.
Add 50 mL glycerol to achieve a final concentration of 10% volume glycerol.
Filter sterilize the solution.
Aliquot 500 µL into cryovials (store at room temperature for up to 6 months; 2 cryovials are required per sample).

steps.title: Prepare Cefotaxime-Supplemented MacConkey Agar
steps.instruction: Prepare the selective media for ESBL-EC recovery.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a cefotaxime stock by dissolving powder in water to 200 mg/mL and store at -20 °C.
Dilute the stock to 10 mg/mL in water to create a working stock solution.
Cool MacConkey agar to 50 °C in a water bath and add cefotaxime to a final concentration of 1 µg/mL.
Pour into sterile petri dishes, allow to dry, and store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Process Samples for Enrichment
steps.instruction: Inoculate BPW enrichment broth based on sample type.

substeps.instruction: For swabs: Transfer the rectal swab into a 15 mL falcon tube containing 5 mL of BPW, cut the end of the swab, and replace the cap.

For stool samples: Weigh the stool sample pot (zeroing with an empty pot) and resuspend in stool solution using 5x the volume of solution per gram of stool (e.g., 0.5 g stool = 2.5 mL stool solution).
Agitate stool samples using a small stirrer bar on a magnetic stirrer; vortex if necessary.
Add 100 µL of the resuspended stool into a 15 mL falcon tube containing 5 mL of BPW.

steps.title: Incubate and Primary Streak
steps.instruction: Perform initial enrichment and selective plating.

substeps.instruction: Incubate tubes shaking at 220 rpm, 37 °C, for 4 hours.
Transfer samples to a Class II microbiological safety cabinet (MSC).
Streak each sample onto MacConkey agar supplemented with 1 µg/mL cefotaxime using a 1 µL loop.
Incubate plates overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Isolate and Purify Colonies
steps.instruction: Select and restreak positive colonies for purity.

substeps.instruction: Pick several positive morphology colonies (red/pink on MacConkey agar).
Streak each colony onto a separate section of a new MacConkey agar plate supplemented with 1 µg/mL cefotaxime.
Incubate plates overnight at 37 °C.
Transfer a 1 µL loopful of each colony restreak to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Extract and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction and concentration measurement.

substeps.instruction: Extract DNA according to the Lucigen MasterPure Complete DNA and RNA Purification kit manual.
Measure the concentration of all DNA extracts using a Qubit according to the manufacturer's recommendations.
